items.headline: Freeze Watch issued October 23 at 8:41AM EDT until October 24 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
items.areaDesc: Morris; Hunterdon; Somerset; Berks; Lehigh; Western Chester; Western Montgomery; Upper Bucks
items.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 32 possible.

* WHERE...In New Jersey, Morris, Somerset, and Hunterdon Counties. In
Pennsylvania, Berks, Lehigh, Upper Bucks, Western Chester, and
Western Montgomery Counties.

* WHEN...From late tonight through Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.
items.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 23 at 3:13AM EDT until October 24 at 12:00AM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
items.areaDesc: Inland Sussex; Delaware Beaches; Ocean; Coastal Ocean
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level in
low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...In Delaware, Inland Sussex and Delaware Beaches. In
New Jersey, Ocean and Coastal Ocean.

* WHEN...Until midnight EDT tonight.

* IMPACTS...At this level, flooding begins on the most
vulnerable roads in coastal and bayside communities, and along
inland tidal waterways. Some partial or full road closures are
possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Elevated water levels and minor coastal
flooding will continue through this evening particularly for
the back bays.
items.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Advisory means that minor tidal flooding is
expected. Minor tidal flooding often results in some road
closures. Usually, the most vulnerable roadways will flood.

Do not leave your vehicle at a location that is prone to tidal
flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flood waters. The
water may be deeper than you think it is. You will be putting
yourself in danger and your vehicle may be damaged, leading to
costly repairs.

Visit the National Water Prediction Service at
https://water.noaa.gov/wfo/phi for additional water level and
flood impact information for your local tide gauge.

items.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 23 at 2:42AM EDT until October 24 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Upton NY
items.areaDesc: Southern Fairfield; Southern New Haven; Southern Middlesex; Southern New London; Southern Westchester
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 33 will result in frost formation.

* WHERE...In Connecticut, Southern Fairfield, Southern Middlesex,
Southern New Haven, and Southern New London Counties. In New York,
Southern Westchester County.

* WHEN...From 11 PM this evening to 9 AM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
items.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
